facts.name: SRM University-AP Overview
facts.detail: SRM University-AP, Andhra Pradesh, is a multi-disciplinary research-intensive institute combining academic rigour, evolving research ecosystem, entrepreneurial heritage, and pioneering faculty.

facts.name: Tagline
facts.detail: Globally Connected, Regionally Transformative and Nationally Relevant

facts.name: University Collaborations
facts.detail: 60+ Collaborations with the world's best Universities

facts.name: Campus
facts.detail: 100 acre Campus designed by Perkins & Will

facts.name: Vision
facts.detail: To emerge as a world-class University in creating and disseminating knowledge and providing students a unique learning experience in their chosen field of scholarship that would best serve the society and betterment of mankind.

facts.name: Mission 1
facts.detail: Develop into an inter-disciplinary institute combining academic rigour, excitement of discovery, creativity and entrepreneurship

facts.name: Mission 2
facts.detail: Deliver world-class research-based education, creating new knowledge and innovations

facts.name: Mission 3
facts.detail: Provide an inspiring and stimulating environment for a diverse campus community of faculty and students

facts.name: Core Values
facts.detail: Show Compassion, Develop Trust, Give Mutual Respect, Create a sense of Curiosity, Serve with Integrity, Instil Social Responsibility

facts.name: Location
facts.detail: Neerukonda, Mangalagiri Mandal, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh - 522240, located between Vijayawada and Guntur, nearest town is Mangalagiri

facts.name: Connectivity
facts.detail: Nearest airport is Vijayawada Airport, 40 km away. Nearest major railway stations are Vijayawada Junction (23 km) and Guntur Junction (31 km). NH16 is in close proximity. Nearest major bus stations are in Mangalagiri, Vijayawada, and Guntur.
